title: Do physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) need to be deep? Shallow PINNs using the Levenberg-Marquardt algorithm
abstract: arXiv:2602.08515v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: This work investigates shallow physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) for solving forward and inverse problems governed by nonlinear partial differential equations (PDEs). By formulating PINN training as a nonlinear least-squares problem, the Levenberg-Marquardt (LM) algorithm is used to efficiently optimize the network parameters. Exact analytical expressions for neural-network derivatives with respect to the input variables are derived, revealing the relationships between the network output and its spatial and temporal derivatives and providing a clearer interpretation of the PINN architecture. These expressions are then used to derive explicit formulas for the Jacobian matrix required by LM. The proposed approach is evaluated on the Burgers, Schr\"odinger, Allen-Cahn, and three-dimensional Bratu equations. translated_title: 物理信息神经网络（PINNs）需要很深吗？使用Levenberg-Marquardt算法的浅层PINNs
translated_abstract: 本文研究了用于求解由非线性偏微分方程（PDEs）控制的正向和逆向问题的浅层物理信息神经网络（PINNs）。通过将PINN训练表述为非线性最小二乘问题，采用Levenberg-Marquardt（LM）算法来高效优化网络参数。推导了神经网络相对于输入变量的精确解析导数表达式，揭示了网络输出与其空间和时间导数之间的关系，为PINN架构提供了更清晰的解释。这些表达式随后被用于推导LM所需的雅可比矩阵的显式公式。所提出的方法在Burgers、Schrödinger、Allen-Cahn和三维Bratu方程上进行了评估。数值结果表明，LM在收敛速度、精度和稳定性方面显著优于BFGS、L-BFGS和Adam。
tldr: 本文证明浅层物理信息神经网络结合Levenberg-Marquardt算法能够高效求解非线性偏微分方程，并显著优于传统优化方法。
en_tdlr: This paper demonstrates that shallow physics-informed neural networks with the Levenberg-Marquardt algorithm can efficiently solve nonlinear PDEs, significantly outperforming traditional optimizers.
